task.population: The phlebotomy-weighted complete-measurement domain of nonpregnant women aged 20–44 in NHANES August 2021–August 2023; RIDEXPRG=2, both measured hemoglobin and raw ferritin, positive phlebotomy weight. Pregnancy unknown/incomplete excluded; no CRP restriction. Equal-weight virtual rows represent this domain only under explicit transport assumptions. No individual measurements or target outcome summaries are supplied.

excluded_cohorts: National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey

model.law: Independent draws from a Gaussian copula with bounded logistic-normal hemoglobin and a monotone piecewise log-normal-score ferritin marginal.

transport.threshold_probabilities: Assume the source four-cell probabilities apply to the target domain.
transport.ferritin_geometric_mean: Assume the source geometric mean of 17.4 ug/L applies to the target domain.
transport.representation: Equal-weight rows represent the phlebotomy-weighted complete-measurement target domain only under these transport assumptions; source counts are not survey weights.

ferritin.mapping: log(F)=log(threshold)+s_side*(Z_F-k), where k=Phi_inverse(p_F), s_side=s_low below k and s_high otherwise.
